sources.entry: tmux-claude-status-tabs by LiveNL - Shows each Claude Code session's state in the tmux tab bar, per window: an animated spinner while it works, amber when it waits on input, red on a permission request, green when done. Event-driven via hooks with no polling; catches unreported transitions (Esc, permission grants, stop-hook continuations) with transcript watchers. 260+ test assertions run in CI.

summary.one_liner: A tmux plugin that shows each Claude Code session's state (running, waiting for input, permission request, done) in its window's tab bar, driven by Claude Code hooks.
summary.what_it_does: Colors and animates each tmux window tab to reflect the state of the Claude Code session running in it. A spinner ticks while Claude works, amber "?" marks a question waiting for input, red "!" marks a permission request, and green "✓" marks a finished turn. Claude Code hooks repaint the tab within about half a second of each lifecycle event. A verifier periodically checks each tab against Claude Code's per-session status to catch transitions Claude does not report, such as Esc, granted permissions, or stop-hook continuations. The installer copies hook scripts into ~/.claude/hooks/ and merges their wiring into ~/.claude/settings.json, backing up the file first. On macOS it sends desktop notifications via osascript, and with alerter they become clickable to jump to the waiting window.
use_cases: see which Claude Code session needs attention across many tmux windows
monitor multiple parallel Claude Code sessions
get notified when Claude is waiting for input or approval
customize tmux window status colors for AI agent sessions
jump to the tmux window where Claude is waiting
how_to_run: Add source-file /path/to/tmux-claude-status-tabs/tmux/claude-state.conf to ~/.tmux.conf and reload tmux (or prepend the fragment from tmux/claude-state-prefix.txt to your window-status-format)
notable: Event-driven hooks with no polling, plus transcript watchers that catch transitions Claude Code never reports
Per-window tab states: animated spinner, amber ?, red !, green ✓
Questions latch and finished turns keep their color until the next event
Desktop notifications on macOS with optional clickable alerter support that focuses the waiting window
Test suite of 300+ assertions run in CI, including contract tests against real Claude payloads and session files
caveats: Requires tmux 3.0 or newer, jq, and the Claude Code CLI
Desktop notifications are built for macOS only; other platforms skip them silently
Installer modifies ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.tmux.conf must be edited by hand to load the plugin
